thread:
eva: Heads-up — deploybot started the release window for v3.4.0 at 13:05 UTC, I'm seeing a small p95 drift on canaries. tagging @deploybot for details :eyes:

deploybot: automated-checks: canary p95 420ms -> 890ms (↑112%). error rate +0.8%. traffic slice: canary-10%. suggest: hold for 30m or rollback.

maria: hold. release notes still missing the DB migration caveat from the PR. customers will be surprised.

jonathan: +1 to hold. ops, is there a quick rollback plan if we need it?

sre-bot: alert: increased tail latency correlated with kernel flag experiment (kvm-shared=on). stack traces show KV cache misses.

ops-lead: we have two options: (A) manual rollback to v3.3.7 (pin) which is fast, or (B) abort canary and cut traffic back to stable while we investigate. preference: pin if customer-facing risks.

release-eng: I can patch release notes now. if we pin, I'll update notes and notify CSMs.

jonathan: okay plan: 1) manual pin v3.3.7 for all canary hosts, 2) mark change-window hard-stop (no further merges), 3) inform support + customers. anyone object?

maria: no objection. do we need legal/comms? small wording change only.

ops-lead: executing pin. tagging @deploybot to run the rollback workflow. when done, post final status.

deploybot: rollback workflow triggered by ops-lead at 13:07:30 UTC. run-id: rb-1766612345-01. steps: drain -> rollback -> health-check -> restore traffic. ETA ~ 4m.

jonathan: attaching quick commands for the exec team:
```bash
# pin to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:3.3.7 -n prod
# verify pods restart and pass readiness
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference -n prod --timeout=180s
```

ops-lead: running now. starting drain on canary-1..4.

deploybot: drain complete (canary-1..4). rolling back image on 4 pods.

release-eng: release notes patched with migration caveat and rollback blurb. publishing rn-diff to #release-notes for CSM review.

maria: thanks, release-eng. I'll prep a short customer-facing blurb: "We observed elevated tail latency after an optimization; we've reverted to the previous stable build and are investigating."

deploybot: health checks passing on rolled-back pods. p95 stable at 410ms. run-id rb-1766612345-01 completed at 13:11:10 UTC.

jonathan: confirm: we've pinned traffic and executed rollback. ops, please keep the release window blocked until postmortem.

ops-lead: confirmed. change-window: hard-stop engaged. no merges until postmortem ticket is triaged. I've created INC-17666 and invited oncall for 2h follow-up.

eva: thanks team. comms plan: ops to update #prod-status + send note to CSMs, release-eng to finalize release notes, SRE to triage kernel flag interaction. I'll follow up with a short postmortem template. :thumbsup:

release-eng: posted final release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0-rollback. brief sent to CSMs.

maria: sending customer email draft now, will link RN.

jonathan: closing thread after postmortem scheduling. good catch and quick execution.

ops-lead: ack, leaving the hard-stop until the postmortem is complete.

sre-bot: monitor: elevated KV-cache rebuilds tracing to kernel flag experiment. assigning to @jonathan for deeper debug.
